_what: What the pages remember on a device: a way the person said Not now to (passkey, password) is not offered again for this many days (old Trillion's after_sign_in.skip_days). `remembered_seconds`: an AI the person already allowed is shown "Connecting" with an Undo for this long before it is let through. `read_only_drops`: the scopes the Read only switch on the consent screen leaves out (every other scope asked for is kept; a read-only variant of one is named here when the engine has it).
